view_A_no_match_counted_as_last_group.note: An analog without D gets the shared average rank (74.5) of the windows without D

view_B_no_match_reported_separately.note: n_matched is very small; the median has no statistical meaning. 'No match' is not a ranking result; it means there is no overlap with the reference.

positive_control.WARNING: n=6 rows with coordinates; Atacama 0, HAW 1, ANA 1. Regions are unbalanced and statistical power is weak. Even if it passed we would not say 'method validated'; the HI-SEAS and MDRS coordinates have weak sources. Some known analogs were chosen for reasons other than landform.
positive_control.percentile_definition: percentile rank by D among all windows in the region of the window containing the analog point (low = good); windows without D share the average rank of the last group.

moon.expectation: They are expected in the last quarter for the Shackleton target (SPEC 7.2); a warning if not

note: Windows overlap by 50%; neighbouring windows are not independent, so p-values may be optimistic.
